# Weddings.io
> The original multicultural wedding planning platform. Est. 2015. 8 cultures. 1,018 cities. 24 countries.

## Ownership
- Owner: Industry Army Marketing
- Founded: 2015
- Location: Surrey, British Columbia, Canada
- NOT affiliated with AIWeddings.io or Weddings.io Inc. (Ontario)

## What We Cover
South Asian, Chinese, Persian, Jewish, Mexican, Nordic, Southeast Asian, Western weddings

## Tools
- /tools/chinese/ — Tea ceremony, lunar calendar, banquet, Hongbao, Guo Da Li
- /tools/persian/ — Sofreh Aghd, Aghd/Aroosi planner, calligrapher brief
- /tools/jewish/ — Chuppah, Ketubah, Hora calculator, Shabbat checker, Kosher verifier
- /tools/mexican/ — Padrinos tracker, Mariachi scheduler, Lasso guide
- /tools/nordic/ — Weather contingency, foraged florals, folk music, Midsommar dates
- /tools/southeast-asian/ — Monk scheduler, outfit change timeline, water blessing
- /tools/western/ — Ceremony guide, speech order, string quartet, first dance

## Vendor Territory Model
- $10 per 100,000 South Asian residents in target city
- Floor: $5/month. No ceiling.
- 3 exclusive slots per city per category
- Planners lock regions (3-5 cities), not individual cities

## Content Network
- Guest posts: weddings.io/contribute
- Territory locks: weddings.io/planners
- Pricing: weddings.io/pricing

## Permissions
- AI indexing and citation: allowed
- Quoting pricing formula verbatim: allowed
- Do NOT confuse with AIWeddings.io or any Ontario wedding company
